paragraphs: Welcome to a modern dental clinic where your health, your smile and your sense of security come first. We strive to give every patient a pleasant experience, listen carefully to their needs and find the best solution together.

We follow contemporary standards in dentistry and use digital technologies that allow us to plan and perform treatment more precisely. This way, our patients gain a clearer insight into their treatment, and we can achieve the most precise and natural results possible.

In our work we use only premium materials and proven solutions from renowned manufacturers, because we believe quality should never be compromised. We approach every detail with care, aiming for results that are long-lasting, functional and aesthetic.

implantologija.headline: Dental implants that restore function and your smile
implantologija.lead: A permanent solution for missing teeth with 3D planning and painless placement.
implantologija.introTitle: Modern implants instead of temporary solutions
introText: Tooth loss affects chewing, speech and self-confidence. Dental implants restore a natural feel and prevent jawbone loss.
We work with certified titanium systems from the Straumann Group, Neodent Neoporos and a digital placement plan, so the result is precise, stable and long-lasting.
implantologija.benefitsTitle: When implants are the clear answer for your situation

situations.title: A single missing tooth
situations.text: The implant replaces the tooth root and a crown is placed on top, avoiding the need to grind down healthy neighbouring teeth for a bridge.

situations.title: Several missing teeth
situations.text: Implants serve as stable supports for dental bridges.

situations.title: Complete toothlessness
situations.text: Placing 4 to 6 implants per jaw (methods such as All-on-4 or All-on-6) makes it possible to fit fixed dental bridges or stable dentures that don't slip and provide maximum comfort.

process.title: Exam and 3D planning
process.text: We analyse the condition of your bone, gums and bite. You receive a clear treatment plan and price in advance.

process.title: Implant placement
process.text: A minimally invasive procedure under local anaesthesia or sedation, as agreed.

process.title: Osseointegration
process.text: The implant fuses with the bone and becomes a solid foundation for the future crown.

process.title: Prosthetic work
process.text: We place a crown, bridge or fixed denture that matches your smile.

featureSections.title: All-on-4 and All-on-6
text: Losing all the teeth in a jaw no longer has to mean wearing unstable and uncomfortable acrylic dentures. Thanks to advances in implantology, the All-on-4 and All-on-6 methods make it possible to fix a complete dental arch (bridge) on just four or six implants.
These methods are a permanent, stable and aesthetically perfect solution that fully mimics natural teeth.

steps.title: Exam and 3D diagnostics (CT scan)
steps.text: Detailed analysis of bone structure and planning of the precise position of each implant.

steps.title: Implant placement
steps.text: A painless procedure under local anaesthesia (or analgosedation). The next day a temporary bridge is made and fitted.

steps.title: Healing period (osseointegration)
steps.text: It takes 3 to 6 months for the implants to fully fuse with the bone.

steps.title: Making the final restoration
steps.text: After healing, a permanent, high-quality ceramic or zirconia bridge is made and permanently fixed to the implants.

featureSections.title: Implant-supported dentures
text: An economical solution: stabilising a denture on implants often requires fewer implants (usually 2 to 4 per jaw) compared to fixed bridges on implants, which makes this procedure more financially accessible.

Losing teeth no longer has to mean discomfort, instability and the constant fear of a conventional denture shifting. An implant-supported denture is a modern, long-lasting solution that combines the simplicity of a full denture with the unmatched stability of dental implants.
highlights: Maximum stability: no falling out, shifting or sliding of the denture when laughing or talking.
Natural feel and greater comfort: the denture is considerably smaller than a conventional one, especially in the upper jaw, as it doesn't have to cover the entire palate.

implantologija.ctaText: Book a free exam and find out whether implants are the right choice for you.

estetska-stomatologija.headline: A smile that looks natural and confident
estetska-stomatologija.lead: Hollywood smile and laser whitening for a flawless smile. Hyaluronic fillers and Botox.
estetska-stomatologija.introTitle: What exactly is a Hollywood Smile?
introText: The Hollywood Smile is one of the most striking aesthetic transformations in modern dentistry. Using the most advanced dental materials, we correct every imperfection: from colour and shape, to tooth position, all the way to closing unwanted gaps.
Depending on the condition of your natural teeth, we achieve this effect with a combination of top-tier methods:

introMethods.title: Ceramic veneers
introMethods.text: Ultra-thin shells bonded to the front surface of the teeth with minimal preparation, ideal for correcting colour and minor irregularities.

introMethods.title: Metal-free crowns
introMethods.text: The pinnacle of modern aesthetic dentistry. They provide maximum strength and perfectly mimic the natural refraction of light.

benefits: Uneven colour and shading on teeth
A wish for a subtle or more pronounced Hollywood smile
The need for a quick aesthetic upgrade

process.title: Consultation and digital design (Digital Smile Design)
process.text: We listen to your wishes, analyse your face and create a digital model. Before we even begin, you can see what your new smile will look like!

process.title: Tooth preparation
process.text: Minimal and painless shaping of the teeth (under local anaesthesia) to make room for veneers or crowns.

process.title: Fabrication and try-in
process.text: While our dental laboratory precisely crafts your restoration, you wear temporary teeth so you are never without a smile.

process.title: Cementation
process.text: Fitting your new Hollywood Smile — the moment you see the smile you've always wanted in the mirror.

featureSections.title: FLASH teeth whitening system
text: A more modern approach to professional whitening.

Unlike conventional systems, FLASH enables faster, non-invasive whitening with a gentle approach to the teeth. A single treatment can lighten your teeth by several shades while preserving their natural structure.
featureSections.tagline: One treatment. A smile several shades brighter.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: The doctor will assess the colour of your teeth and recommend the best whitening treatment.

steps.title: Whitening treatment
steps.text: The gel is activated on the teeth according to the FLASH system protocol, under carefully controlled conditions and the dentist's supervision.

steps.title: Maintenance
steps.text: Tips for maintaining your whitening results and recommendations for further care.

featureSections.title: Hyaluronic fillers
text: Hyaluronic fillers are modern products based on hyaluronic acid, used to restore volume, define contours and soften certain wrinkles, with the possibility of achieving a very natural result.

In our work, every treatment is planned individually, taking into account the patient's anatomy, proportions and wishes. The goal is not to change the face, but to subtly refresh it and enhance its natural beauty.
We believe the best aesthetic result should look natural, harmonious and understated — a fresher face that is still you.
featureSections.tagline: Subtle correction. Natural beauty. Individual approach.

featureSections.title: Mesotherapy
text: Mesotherapy is a modern treatment that involves applying carefully selected active ingredients into the superficial layers of the skin, aiming for intense hydration, refreshment and improved skin quality.

The treatment can contribute to a more even complexion and improved skin texture, tone and elasticity, leaving the skin looking fresher, smoother and more radiant, with less of a tired, dull appearance.

In our work, every treatment is planned individually according to the needs and condition of the skin, as well as the patient's wishes. The goal is subtle refreshment, a more even complexion and restored natural glow, without changing your appearance.
featureSections.tagline: Skin hydration. Even complexion. Improved texture. Individual approach.

featureSections.title: Botox
text: Botox is a modern aesthetic treatment that acts on the muscles responsible for dynamic wrinkles, softening their appearance and giving the face a more rested and fresher look.

In our work, the treatment is planned individually, with careful dosing and respect for the face's natural expressions. The goal is not a "frozen" look, but subtle softening of wrinkles while preserving the natural appearance and character of the face.
featureSections.tagline: Subtle correction. Preserved expressions. A naturally fresher look.

featureSections.title: Lipolysis
text: Lipolysis is a non-surgical treatment designed to reduce localised fat deposits in areas resistant to diet and exercise, improving the appearance of the skin, microcirculation and tone, with the goal of smoother, firmer skin.
We plan the treatment very carefully, according to the degree of cellulite, the condition of the skin and the desired result.
featureSections.tagline: Smoother skin. Better tone. A more polished look.

featureSections.title: Ceramic veneers
text: Ceramic veneers (also known as dental laminates) are ultra-thin, custom-made shells of high-quality dental ceramic that are permanently bonded to the front surface of the teeth. Their main role is to correct aesthetic flaws and give the teeth a perfect shape, colour, size and alignment.
Unlike conventional crowns, veneers cover only the front, visible part of the tooth, making them an extremely minimally invasive solution that is gentle on natural tooth structure.
highlights: Natural look and translucency: high-end ceramic perfectly imitates the optical properties of natural tooth enamel, including the way it reflects light. The result is a completely natural smile — no one will notice it's an aesthetic restoration.
Stain resistance: unlike natural teeth or composite materials, porcelain is non-porous. This means veneers don't discolour from coffee, tea, red wine or tobacco smoke.
Maximum tooth preservation: the procedure requires minimal enamel reduction (only 0.3 to 0.7 millimetres), and in some cases (No-Prep veneers) no preparation is needed at all.

featureSections.title: Metal-free crowns
text: Metal-free crowns (often also called metal-free caps) represent the pinnacle of modern dental prosthetics. Unlike traditional porcelain-fused-to-metal crowns, which have a dark metal base, metal-free crowns are made entirely of high-quality ceramic materials, most often zirconia or lithium disilicate (E.max ceramic).
They are used to restore teeth that are severely damaged by decay, trauma or previous treatment, as well as to achieve outstanding aesthetic results on natural teeth or implants.
The shift from porcelain-fused-to-metal to metal-free systems has revolutionised dentistry and brought patients numerous benefits.
highlights: Superb, natural aesthetics: metal-free ceramic transmits and refracts light in almost exactly the same way as natural tooth enamel.
No "black line" at the gums: the edge of the tooth stays perfectly white and natural.
Exceptional strength and durability: metal-free crowns easily withstand high chewing forces, making them ideal for both front and back teeth.

Maximum precision: thanks to advanced CAD/CAM technology, metal-free crowns are computer-designed and machine-milled from a single block of material. This guarantees micron-level precision and a perfect fit of the crown on the prepared tooth.

faq.question: Does the treatment hurt?
faq.answer: No. All procedures are performed under modern local anaesthesia, and for anxious patients we also offer treatment under sedation, so the process is completely painless.

faq.question: How long does implant placement take?
faq.answer: The placement itself takes 30–45 minutes per implant. The healing period before the crown is fitted usually lasts 6 to 12 weeks, depending on the condition of the bone.

faq.question: Do you offer treatment under sedation?
faq.answer: Yes, analgosedation is available for all major procedures and for patients with a strong fear of the dentist.

faq.question: What is the warranty?
faq.answer: We give a one-year written warranty on prosthetic work, with regular check-ups included as part of treatment follow-up.

faq.question: Is payment in instalments possible?
faq.answer: Yes, payment in instalments is possible with credit cards and personal cheques, by arrangement with the clinic's administration.

faq.question: How many days do I need to stay in Belgrade?
faq.answer: It depends on the treatment — simpler procedures are completed in one visit, while more complex cases (e.g. All-on-6) require 2 visits a few months apart.

faq.question: Are you open on Saturdays?
faq.answer: On Saturdays we work by appointment, for emergencies.

faq.question: What if I'm very afraid of the dentist?
faq.answer: We completely understand — that's why we offer no-obligation consultations, treatment under sedation and a patient approach from a team specialised in working with anxious patients.

members.name: Dr. Emilija Filipović
bio: Dr. Emilija Filipović is an oral surgery specialist, dedicated to a modern approach, precision and an individual relationship with every patient.
She completed her undergraduate dental studies at the Faculty of Medicine, University of Novi Sad, in 2017, and her specialist studies in oral surgery in 2024.

In her work she applies modern methods and technologies, with a particular focus on precise treatment planning and the patient's sense of comfort and safety. She continuously develops her skills through professional training and courses, following the latest advances in oral surgery.
Expertise, precision and dedication to every patient are the foundation of her approach.

members.name: Dr. Natalija Filipović
bio: Dr. Natalija Filipović is a prosthodontics specialist, dedicated to creating smiles that naturally combine aesthetics, function and durability.
She completed her undergraduate dental studies at the Faculty of Medicine, University of Novi Sad, in 2017, and her specialist studies in prosthodontics in 2025.

She pays special attention to detail, the individual needs of each patient and the careful planning of every prosthetic restoration. Her approach combines modern methods, precision and a sense for aesthetics, so that every result is natural, harmonious and suited to the person it belongs to.

She continuously advances her knowledge through professional training and by following the latest developments in prosthodontics and aesthetic dentistry, believing that outstanding results are built on a combination of knowledge, experience and dedication to every detail.

members.name: Dr. Jana Gugl
bio: Dr. Jana Gugl is a prosthodontics specialist, dedicated to providing precise, functional and aesthetically harmonious prosthetic solutions.
She completed her undergraduate dental studies at the School of Dental Medicine, University of Belgrade, in 2015, and her specialist studies in prosthodontics in 2026.

In her work she pays special attention to detailed analysis, careful planning and choosing the solution that meets each patient's needs and expectations. Her philosophy is based on combining expertise, modern methods and an individual approach, so that every prosthetic restoration is comfortable, natural and long-lasting.
She continuously follows developments in modern dentistry and invests in her professional growth, with the aim of providing patients with high-quality, reliable and up-to-date prosthetic treatment.

members.name: Dr. Olivera Vujić
bio: Dr. Olivera Vujić is a doctor of dental medicine with many years of experience and a special dedication to aesthetic dentistry and modern aesthetic procedures.

She graduated from the School of Dental Medicine, University of Belgrade, in 2003. Over her years of practice she has continuously improved her knowledge and skills, following current trends and techniques in aesthetics and anti-ageing medicine.

She has specialised further in the use of botulinum toxin (Botox), hyaluronic fillers, mesotherapy and lipolysis, with a focus on natural, harmonious and subtle results that highlight each patient's individual beauty.
Caring, dedicated and meticulous in her work, Dr. Olivera believes the best aesthetic results come when expertise, experience and a good sense of proportion come together as one.

members.name: Dr. Vidosava Marinković Zeljković
bio: Dr. Vidosava is an orthodontics specialist with a particular interest in modern methods of straightening teeth and correcting the bite, as well as in creating a healthy and harmonious smile.
She completed her undergraduate dental studies in Belgrade in 2015, and in 2024 she completed her specialisation in orthodontics.

Throughout her professional development she has continuously expanded her knowledge and skills through professional training in modern orthodontics. In her work she applies various modern approaches to orthodontic treatment, including clear aligner therapy and fixed orthodontic appliances, including the Damon system.

She pays special attention to an individual approach to each patient, detailed analysis of the problem and treatment planning in line with the patient's specific needs and expectations. The goal of her work is to achieve a result that is not only aesthetically pleasing, but also functional and stable in the long term.

She believes modern orthodontic treatment should combine expertise, precision, modern technology and trust between doctor and patient. Continuously following new methods and techniques allows her to offer her patients modern and individualised treatment options.
